title: Heat and time controls.
officialText:
Sauna heaters shall be equipped with a thermostat which will limit room temperature to 194°F (90°C).
If the thermostat is not an integral part of the sauna heater, the heat-sensing element shall be located within 6 inches (152 mm) of the
ceiling. If the heat-sensing element is a capillary tube and bulb, the assembly shall be attached to the wall or other support, and shall
be protected against physical damage.
